get_cluster_type_auto: get the current cluster type by auto-detecting from the system hostname and OS
get_cluster_type_explicit: get the cluster type by passing an explicit ClusterType enum value
get_slurm_parameters_aws: get SLURM parameters for an AWS cluster by passing an OmegaConf DictConfig
get_slurm_parameters_rsc: get SLURM parameters for an RSC cluster with partition set to learn
use_ClusterType_enum: use the ClusterType enum to reference AWS, FAIR, RSC, Darwin, or Default cluster types
